French President Emmanuel Macron has spoken about a shift in the position of his US counterpart Donald Trump regarding Russia's war against Ukraine following the G7 summit.

Source: Macron in an interview with TV channel France 2, as reported by European Pravda

Details: Macron used the opportunity to highlight recent changes in Trump's views.

Quote: "He arrived thinking that Ukraine is losing. But he changed his mind... He also saw that Russia is not keeping its commitments. Yes, during this G7 summit there was a real change [in views – ed.]."
